style: Cinematic stylized 3D-rendered environment in the look of a premium collectible-figure diorama: glossy, detailed, softly lit like a high-end animated film. Soft frontal key light, moody colored rim light, gentle atmospheric haze and depth of field in the far background. Absolutely no people, no characters, no figures, no creatures, no silhouettes, no text, no lettering, no logos, no signage. A wide, clear, mostly flat floor area spans the lower third of the frame with nothing standing in the middle of it, so a small character can stand there later. Eye-level camera, landscape composition, horror mood but inviting, rich color.
